note: Zeiner Campground in Pigeon Lake Provincial Park, on the lake's west shore north of the main Pigeon Lake Campground: Loops A-C for tents and RVs, some sites in forest and others in an open area nearer the beach, plus walk-in tent sites (Loop D); a playground, with beach and forested trails nearby. No dock or boat launch on site; two are a short drive away. Non-biting midges can swarm in spring and summer. Note (2026): a blue-green algae advisory has been in effect on the lake since July 21, 2026. --Claude
